about: Who is who in the revival, with the original-series role next to it. Everything here is from the two series' published cast lists.

main.note: The youngest child of Dwayne Wayne and Whitley Gilbert-Wayne. A freshman at Hillman. The character is new; the parents are not — she is a third-generation television character, descended from a 1984 Cosby Show family.
Shares a surname with the revival's Darlene Duvall (Tichina Arnold). Whether that is a mother, aunt or coincidence has not been confirmed by the show.
Deborah's boyfriend from before Hillman; also on campus, which is the pilot's complication. The football story belongs to him.
In an ongoing conflict with Hazel that the season forces to a head.
Competes for Miss Gilbert Hall — the 2026 inheritor of Whitley's 1988 Miss Hillman pageant run.
Carries the season's African/diaspora identity arguments — the thread the original ran in 1990's anti-apartheid episode.

special_guest.note: The original's Southern belle, from the family Gilbert Hall is named for; became the co-lead after Denise Huxtable's departure.
The math whiz; one half of the original's central couple.
Dwayne's best friend and the original's engine of bad decisions.
Arrived in the original's second-season opener as Jaleesa's freshman roommate; the show's activist.

recurring.note: Denise's first roommate — older, divorced, serious — who captained Gilbert Hall's step team and later married Col. Taylor. She also co-wrote the original's theme song.
The professor students called "Dr. War". (Off screen: Turman was married to Aretha Franklin, who sang the original's theme in seasons 2–5.)
Whitley's pre-med roommate from the second-season reset, now a doctor — the original's longest-running bet, paid off.
Introduced in the original's final-season opener; the institution's authority figure, now in the classroom.
A Hillman student in the original's last two seasons (first appearance in the season-five opener), now in Congress. The revival's boldest claim: this is what campus politics becomes.
Became a regular when the original's sixth season opened in 1992.
Also promoted to regular in the 1992 season opener.
New to this series; we found no trace of Tichina Arnold in the original's cast, so treat the Duvall surname pairing with Rashida as a hint, not a reunion.
A second Dr. Boyer, alongside Kimberly — and the family connection to Raven Goodwin's role in the original's universe is a nice piece of casting trivia we have not confirmed.
Football, and the money and eligibility questions that come with it.
The surname is the original's: Mr. Gaines ran the Pit, the campus food spot the students worked at.

offscreen.denise_huxtable: Denise Huxtable (Lisa Bonet) was the original's first lead — a Cosby Show daughter who moved to Hillman for the spin-off. She left during the first season and the show re-centred on Whitley and Dwayne. The revival's premise puts Deborah in the shadow of the couple who replaced her, which is a joke about television itself.
